title: Windowed VIXEN witness needs documented display provisioning when invoked directly
body: The first queued cx-edmat9 GPU witness exited before AppFlow because DISPLAY was unset. The editor log located the recovery: set DISPLAY=:0 and unset WAYLAND_DISPLAY (the repo-root tools/run-vixen-windowed-captures.sh does this). The custom AppFlow witness has no equivalent setup, so a lane must discover and repeat this environment manually.

title: VIXEN provider-root diagnosis path is absent at documented invocation
body: The recovery check tried bash tools/provider-root.sh kernel --explain from the repo root and bash VIXEN/tools/provider-root.sh; both exited 127 because no such script exists. The actual provider-root setup is only represented in VIXEN/codegen/CMakeLists.txt/CMake configuration, so a lane has to infer the supported path instead of using a documented diagnostic entry point.
